subject: Q1 scoring handback: final synthesis and judgement log
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q1 scoring handback: final synthesis and judgement log

Team,

Attached is the consolidated Q1 scorebook (Q1_scorebook_v3.xlsx) and an evidence index that pulls together customer-facing artifacts we used for the Client Impact objective. High level: the scoring pass is stable except for three items where cross-functional calibration shifted scores by more than 0.5 points (marked in red in the sheet). I captured a short judgement narrative for each objective in the "Judgement Log" tab.

Quick asks:
- Please review the marked rows and the short notes in the Judgement Log by end of day Wed (2027-03-24).
- If you disagree with any judgement, reply with a single sentence rationale and a suggested alternative numeric score.
- If needed, we'll do a 30-min calibration call on Thu (03/25) 09:00 PT — LMK availability.

Two specific areas to flag:
1) Runtime / Cost (OBJ-3): the performance vs. cost tradeoff had mixed signals across Dedicated customers; I propose a conservative 2.8/5. See comment in row 18.
2) Client Impact (OBJ-7): Catalyst Health submitted a detailed usage report; their case materially affects the distribution for the objective — evidence linked in Drive.
3) Reliability SLOs (OBJ-2): transient incidents in February were mitigated but the cadence means our "operational rigor" marker landed lower than expected.

Links: evidence folder — https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QbExample; OPS ticket with incident timeline — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-421

Attachments: Q1_scorebook_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), evidence_index_Catalyst.pdf (PDF summary).

Thanks — please keep replies short so I can synthesize the final narrative.

—Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q1 scoring handback: final synthesis and judgement log

Vanessa —

Thanks for the clear package. Quick question on OBJ-3 (Runtime / Cost): the conservative 2.8 you propose uses a 95th-percentile latency baseline. Did you normalize for the burst workload we saw the week of Feb 8? If not, I think the score should be 3.4 given the mitigation work that shipped Feb 15.

If you want me to, I can drop a one-line note in the Judgement Log and suggest 3.4 as the alternative.

—Laura
VP, Engineering

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q1 scoring handback: final synthesis and judgement log

Thanks — read the packet. Two quick notes: 

- I agree with elevating Client Impact (OBJ-7) by +0.5 for the Catalyst Health case. They provided a usage delta that materially changes the customer-weighted tally. Evidence is attached in the drive link (I pasted a short excerpt to the Judgement Log).
- For OBJ-2 (Reliability SLOs), we should keep the current 2.6 but add a mitigation-level note about runbook gaps; we'll own a short remediation plan before the next cadence.

I'll refrain from further edits unless others push back; happy to join the calibration call.

—Vivek
Head of Product

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Q1 scoring handback: calibration notes and suggested final scores

Forwarding with inline calibration notes (see attached comments in Q1_scorebook_v3.xlsx). My suggested changes (quick list):
- OBJ-3: set to 3.2 (compromise between Laura's 3.4 and Vanessa's 2.8) — rationale: normalized latency + cost amortization.
- OBJ-7: bump to 3.5 as Vivek suggested but add a footnote: "Catalyst Health adjusted weighting per contract terms."
- OBJ-2: keep 2.6, add remediation milestone: "Runbook updates + on-call rotation finalized by 04/15/2027."

Small process ask: let's lock the sheet after EOD Wed, then I will draft the QBR one-pager narrative for execs (objective-level bullets + evidence pointers).

—Marissa
Sr. Manager, Customer Success
